propositions: The test intermittently fails with a message-less AssertionError when one writer's git commit reports rc=1 with empty stderr due to a shared-index race between add and commit calls.

Two concurrent writers issue add and commit as separate run_git_write calls; without transactional serialization of the pair, alpha's commit can consume the whole index including beta's staged file, leaving beta with nothing to commit.

The test design asserts that both writers exit rc=0, but the product never promised that two bare whole-index commits against one repository are both non-empty; test failures occur ~1/25-1/65 runs matching CI flake rate.
Fix requires each worker to commit only its own pathspec rather than the whole index, so a writer losing the add/commit race still has its own change to commit.
Fix requires improving failure assertions to report which inner git command failed and to include both stdout and stderr for diagnostics.
